WORKER_NOTICE.plain: Workers are told what is recorded and why.

gate.hint: Piece pay starts only when its legal preconditions are on record.
gate.honestBody: It records what piece pay rests on; it does not judge it. Whether your CCNL allows piece work, the written notice of rates and your labour consultant’s yes on the make-up and the statement are yours (GATE-PIECE-PAY). Until they are on record the switch stays off.
gate.lawPlain: Piece work must keep a fair pay, rates are told to the workers before they apply, and each worker gets the data of the work done.
gate.noticeRead: Worker notice acknowledged by {read} of {of}: told here, never a block.
gate.recordAll: Record what piece pay rests on
gate.saved: Saved what piece pay rests on.
gate.stopped: Piece pay stops counting from {day}. Open periods stay computable.
gate.stoppedBody: Work done before that day stays payable; open periods can still run.
gate.title: Legal switch

held.emptyBody: A scan by a worker not clocked in appears here.
held.hint: Scans by a worker who was not clocked in. Who it was opens inside one record.
held.notPayBody: This is final. The worker sees it on their statement.
held.refused_one: {count} refused: its attendance day still needs fixing.
held.refused_other: {count} refused: their attendance days still need fixing.
held.title: Held scans

hold.NOT_CLOCKED_IN: Not clocked in at the time of the scan
hold.ON_BREAK: On a break at the time of the scan

kindHint.PIECE_RATE: Pieces at the rate of their operation, made up to the guaranteed pay.

kindHint.TEAM_INCENTIVE: A team’s pieces paid to the team and split, made up to the guaranteed pay.

later.body: Pay periods, the earnings ledger and held scans appear here once piece pay has started at this site.

ledger.noRight: The ledger opens with people.earnings.records and the pay grain.
ledger.title: Earnings ledger

lock.corrections: Later changes become corrections on the next export.
lock.people_one: {count} worker is paid from this period.
lock.people_other: {count} workers are paid from this period.
lock.title: Lock {month} pay period

paper.lead: Tick who signed the paper copy. A worker with no employee record cannot be ticked until linked.
paper.title: Record signed paper copies

pay.hidden: One person’s pay opens with people.earnings.records and the pay grain.
pay.hiddenTitle: Pay figures are hidden for your role
pay.noneBody: A statement comes with the first pay period that pays this person.
pay.ratesHint: Proof the person saw the rates before work started (c.c. art. 2101 c.3).
pay.ratesNone: No rates published to this person.

pdf.held: The statement is still being read.
pdf.recorded: This opening is recorded. An approved statement is kept as it was approved.

period.ran: {month} ran: statements drafted, scans in the ledger.

periods.backBody: Approved statements stand until a new run makes a new revision.

periods.lockedBody: This period is final: later changes are new entries in a correction.
periods.noLines: No figures yet: the run makes them.
periods.noStatements: No statement yet: run the period.
periods.statementsHint: Statements name nobody here: one opens at a time, and each opening is recorded.
periods.title: Pay periods
periods.tooFew: Too few people to show a total

privacy.off: This page shows the legal switch, rates per operation and the pay scheme. Nothing here is about one person: piece pay is off.
privacy.on: Lists show totals per period and line, never a name. One person’s pay opens as one record, and each opening is recorded.

problem.companyData: The company’s legal data are incomplete: complete them in Admin › Companies & sites, then open it again.

publish.noEmployee: {count} with no employee record: told, but their reading is recorded only once they are linked.
publish.noWay: Choose on the floor, printed, or both.
publish.nobody: Nobody to tell: every worker has it, or the site has none.

rates.cut: More rates than this page reads: search to narrow them.

rates.hint: Rate per operation, in versions with effective dates. A new rate is a new version with a reason, never an edit.
rates.noMatchBody: Search for another operation or table.
rates.payHidden: Pay figures are hidden for your role: operations and SMVs only.
rates.tileEmpty: Nothing under this tile: clear it to see every rate.
